newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-MANSELL SET FOR TALKS WITH JORDAN - REPORTS.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MANSELL SET FOR TALKS WITH JORDAN - REPORTS.

text.p: Nigel Mansell is set to meet Formula One team boss Eddie Jordan for talks which could lead to him making an unexpected return to the Grand Prix circuit, according to rumours in British motor racing circles on Tuesday.

Reporters and photographers from Japan and Italy were in contact with British journalists after it was alleged, in reports circulating in Japan, that Mansell was expected to meet Jordan at Silverstone on Wednesday.

The Jordan team, however, was unable to comment on the rumours which followed last week's denials of any link with the 1992 world champion, now 43, who last raced in Formula One, for McLaren, in 1995. Jordan's headquarters were closed for their Christmas party.
